name: the game's light
about: Sean's pick (2026-10-23, issue #321): B by day, C at night. LightLooks blends every dial the two set from day's to night's as the sun goes down: all day's with the sun over night_from_sun (its height, the sun direction's y; ~0.26 is 15 degrees up), all night's under night_full_sun. The sky's own dials stay day's (each change re-lights the sky); the grade steps in grade_steps (each step its own lookup, built once).
